title: Saññāvedayitakathā
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpatti lokuttarāti? Āmantā. Maggo phalaṁ nibbānaṁ, sotāpattimaggo sotāpattiphalaṁ …pe… bojjhaṅgoti? Na hevaṁ vattabbe …pe….
Na vattabbaṁ— “saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpatti lokuttarā”ti? Āmantā. Lokiyāti? Na hevaṁ vattabbe. Tena hi lokuttarāti. Saññāvedayitakathā niṭṭhitā.
